mintAuthority.summary: Ethereum fxUSD is minted CDP-style against protocol collateral and its native fxUSD and PoolManager proxies are administered by ProxyAdmin through a 3-day TimelockController path to a 6-of-9 Safe. The Base LayerZero OFT peer and messaging authorities are reviewed separately under Bridge Risk and do not contribute to native Mint Authority.

controls.label: fxUSD native ProxyAdmin (Ethereum token and PoolManager)

controls.label: fxUSD token proxy (EIP-1967, OZ TransparentUpgradeableProxy)
controls.capDescription: fxUSD is minted only against overcollateralized wstETH/WBTC CDP positions inside f(x) Protocol; supply expands and contracts with collateral and redemptions, not by an off-protocol issuer minter.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770715, EIP-1967 slots confirmed: implementation = 0xf729422d68c2cf00574fb5712972454cf402a9b1 and proxy admin = 0x9b54b7703551d9d0ced177a78367560a8b2edda4 (OZ ProxyAdmin).

controls.label: f(x) Protocol OZ TimelockController (3-day delay)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770536, ProxyAdmin owner() and PoolManager DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE checks identify TimelockController 0x68863fb8855b04509a835082478d6e3d0be4e61a; getMinDelay() returns 259200 seconds. The Timelock can register pools and update pool capacities. The 6-of-9 Safe 0x26B2ec4E02ebe2F54583af25b647b1D619e67BbF passes PROPOSER_ROLE, EXECUTOR_ROLE, and CANCELLER_ROLE checks; complete current TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE history was not recovered from the public RPC.

controls.label: f(x) Protocol governance multisig (6-of-9 Gnosis Safe)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770536, current Safe reads returned threshold 6, nine owners, and no enabled modules for governance Safe 0x26B2ec4E02ebe2F54583af25b647b1D619e67BbF. The Safe passes the Timelock PROPOSER_ROLE, EXECUTOR_ROLE, and CANCELLER_ROLE checks. Current guard reads reverted, so guard state remains unresolved rather than being treated as the prior zero value.

review.evidence: Ethereum fxUSD issuance is the sole reviewed native path. The fxUSD ERC-20 and PoolManager proxies are administered by ProxyAdmin 0x9b54...; ProxyAdmin owner() is TimelockController 0x6886... with a 259,200-second delay, and the 6-of-9 Safe 0x26B2... is the verified proposer/executor/canceller authority. FxUSD minting is restricted to the PoolManager's registered, collateral-gated CDP flow; the reviewed wstETH and WBTC pools have configured debt capacities and operate through collateral and price checks. The native posture remains partially-bounded-admin with raiseable economic cap semantics, not-applicable reconciliation for the on-chain collateral-gated path, and no identified prudential supervisor. The Base OFT peer and LayerZero messaging authority is reviewed under Bridge Risk only and is not part of the global Mint Authority assessment.
